text:
Jun: quick thought  on prefix cache: what if we add a lightweight read-only 'shared view' endpoint so nodes can check residency without grabbing a lease? goal: cut duplicate prefills and slab churn.
Ravi: interesting. does this replace leases or just short-circuit prefill attempts?
Jun: short-circuits. idea: bloom => view => intent flow. bloom is local and cheap (ok false +). view tells you likely owner/flags. if view says 'somebody' then avoid prefill unless intent absent.
Marta: you need versioning. a single owner id is not enough. add epoch + flags. otherwise you get weird owner!=resident cases.
Tess: we have lease tokens for handoff already. extend them to carry a read-proof (nonce+hmac) so other nodes can treat the proof as evidence that no prefill is needed.
Ravi: careful: states include pinned, soft_pin, draining, prefill_inflight. view needs to enumerate these. also we should be conservative when seeing draining or soft_pin.
Jun: race scenario to watch: A checks view -> not present -> starts prefill. B concurrently decides to evict and frees slab. This creates wasted work. we need an intent mechanism that eviction path sees.
Marta: intent proposal: ephemeral claim registered in lease-assigner with TTL. shape: {prefix, claim_epoch, claimant, ttl_ms}. eviction consults lease-assigner; if claim present -> demote not evict.
Tess: do not use etcd for per-prefix intents. need low-latency KV with TTL or keep in lease-assigner memory with replication.
Ravi: +1. if we put intents in lease-assigner, we avoid new infra. but we need load testing on lease-assigner. this increases RPCs.
Jun: what about caching the shared view at caller side? short TTL (200ms?) to avoid extra hops on hot paths. bloom check first then cached view check.
Marta: TTLs: view cache 200ms default, intent TTL 5s w/ 1s heartbeat refresh. eviction can forcibly ignore an intent if heartbeat stale > (ttl + fudge). record as stale-intent in metrics.
Ravi: metrics to add: duplicate_prefills, intent_claims, intent_overrides_by_eviction, view_cache_hits, view_misses. these will show usefulness and tuning.
Tess: security: any proof exposed between nodes must be verifiable. sidecar HMAC signing of proofs. header: X-SV-Proof: base64(sig). Accept missing proofs for backwards compat. behind feature flag for canary.
Jun: sample shared view response (conceptual, returned by /shared_view?pfx=...):

```
{"owner":"node-12","epoch":"42","flags":["pinned"],"ts":"1700000000"}
```

Jun: sample intent claim (stored in lease-assigner):

```
{"prefix":"pfx:hot-123","claim_epoch":"43","claimant":"node-7","ttl_ms":5000}
```

Marta: operational notes: in partitions claimant can lose heartbeats; eviction should proceed after TTL+backoff and increment stale_intent metric. docs must define grace windows for compliance.
Ravi: we must avoid making reads too chatty. flow: local bloom -> cached view -> if view says resident + pinned -> skip prefill. if view says no owner -> attempt to create intent claim (CAS) in lease-assigner; succeed -> prefill; fail -> consult new owner and backoff.
Jun: that CAS in lease-assigner needs to be cheap; metadata only. ephemeral keys with TTL will auto-expire if claimant dies.
Tess: implement HMAC verification in sidecar with rotation keys from infra. proofs include nonce+expiry and are short-lived. old nodes treat proofs as opaque.
Marta: resolution rules when owner != claimant: prefer higher epoch; if epoch equal use lexicographic node id tie-breaker; document that in RFC.
Ravi: rollout plan: step 0: read-only view exposed and instrument duplicate_prefills for 1 week. step 1: enable intent claims behind flag in canary. step 2: widen rollout if metrics positive.
Jun: owners: Jun -> shared view + client cache; Ravi -> eviction + prefill flow; Marta -> intent semantics + metrics; Tess -> sidecar signing + proto. I'll open RFC and assign owners.
Marta: add enum flags in RFC: [pinned, soft_pinned, prefill_intent, draining, unknown]. also note compatibility: missing view == unknown.
Tess: will add header spec and pseudo-API for sidecar verify. also add fallback behavior for nodes that don't send proofs.
Ravi: I'll coordinate with infra to size lease-assigner and add keys for signing.
Jun: @deploy-bot canary cluster?
deploy-bot: reserved cluster-canary-7 for 7 days
Marta: I'll prepare an experiment dashboard (duplicate_prefills, prefill_latency, blocked_evictions, stale_intents).
Jun: great. I'll schedule a 30m sync after RFC draft. thanks all! :rocket:
